limits_and_behavior: Strict YYYY-MM-DD, no timestamps/timezones or surrounding text. Both dates must be real Gregorian dates, years 0001–9999. Arithmetic uses UTC day numbers, so daylight-saving changes cannot create fractional days. Exclusive same-day = 0; inclusive same-day = 1. Reverse signed inclusive distance is −(absolute elapsed days + 1). Weeks/remainder use the absolute counted distance; no business-day, holiday or calendar-month model is assumed.

visual_review.result: PASS: readable headings, fields, results, controls and feedback; no clipping observed. Screenshots are private ignored development artifacts.

limitations: Headless Chromium on Windows; not physical mobile, Safari, Firefox, screen-reader or native IME certification.
Clipboard/download mocked; no native clipboard or Save-dialog claim.
External HTTP(S) blocked; fallback CSS reviewed. Hosting/CDN delivery is separate from local input processing.
Implementation remains TESTED, not merged, deployed or publicly verified.
Installed dashboard and shortcuts are preserved; this audit makes no new native GUI launch claim.
